rubrics.justification: The response misclassifies the embryo as a morula despite visible cavitation consistent with an early blastocyst on day 4. It also infers good compaction and lack of fragmentation without adequately addressing the poorly defined/indistinct ICM and TE quality.
It integrates age, ovarian reserve, tubal factor, prior miscarriages, sperm parameters, and endometrial thickness reasonably well with prognosis, though some links are somewhat generalized.
The overall logic is structured, but the core morphological misclassification weakens downstream conclusions, including the staging-based prognosis and transfer discussion.

Much of the counseling is broadly evidence-based, but recommending PGT-A as highly recommended in a 28-year-old primarily due to miscarriage history is stronger than guideline-supported practice, and routine thrombophilia screening/heparin suggestions are not universally aligned.

Provides practical next steps for transfer support and future evaluation, including RPL workup and uterine assessment, though some recommendations would benefit from more guideline-based qualification.
